A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work and all 38 pages, including Appendices A–H. Extracted text and rendered page bodies match exactly after excluding publication headers and the arXiv stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original OGbench experiments in Section 6 and additional ablations, trajectory-free FetchReach experiments, and online evaluations in Appendix H.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Section 6 and Appendices G–H, including benchmark scores, ablations, and trajectory-free and online evaluations.

M1.justification: The Eik-QRL and Eik-HiQRL architectures, objectives, training procedures, and policy extraction in Sections 4–5 and Appendices C–D are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same OGbench navigation and manipulation tasks, trajectory-free FetchReach setting, and online Pointmaze and FetchReach scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within corresponding experiments, including QRL and HJB-QRL in Table 1, Eik-HIQL/HIQL/QRL/CRL in Table 2, and QRL:hi and HiQRL comparisons in Appendix H.

E3.justification: Training budgets, metrics, evaluation schedules, and sample sizes are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains 100,000 training steps and evaluations over five goals with 50 episodes per goal.

E4.justification: Appendix H retains the same actor and optimization ablations, Eik-HiQRL versus HiQRL analysis, and trajectory-free study. The robustness investigations and supplementary analyses are unchanged.

E5.justification: Seed counts, mean and standard-deviation reporting, and Welch’s t-tests are identical, including 10 seeds for the main comparisons and eight seeds for Figure 27.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted curves are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 reports Eik-HiQRL success of 59 ± 7 on antmaze-giant-navigate in both versions.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, Lemma 4.7, Theorem 4.8, their Appendix A proofs, and the hierarchy/quasimetric analysis in Appendix B are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution statements, and conclusion retain identical claims about trajectory-free value learning, theoretical guarantees, hierarchical design, and empirical performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of PDE regularization and hierarchy are unchanged, as are limitations concerning isotropic dynamics, Lipschitz regularity, and contact-induced discontinuities in manipulation.

D1.justification: Implementation details, Algorithm 1, Table 3 hyperparameters, Appendix G hardware and timing information, and Section 8’s code-release statement are identical.

R1.justification: Section 2, the reference list, and comparisons positioning the work relative to prior research are unchanged. No cited works are added or removed.

P1.justification: The running header changes from 'Preprint. Under review.' to 'Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026'. The arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 12 Dec 2025 to v2 dated 2 Mar 2026. Body prose and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, axes, legends, and their placement are identical. The header and version-stamp text updates leave the document layout unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 updates publication and version metadata while retaining identical scientific content, evidence, explanations, and reproducibility information throughout the main text and appendices. These metadata edits do not meaningfully change the paper’s overall quality.
